how: Supabase MCP get_advisors(security) and execute_sql with the catalog queries in _work/machine-pass.md section 1. Read-only.
not_checked: Query 4a (pg_proc: security definer list with proconfig settings and proacl) could-not-check: the execute_sql call needed a person's approval and this run was unattended (refused twice). So definer_functions is built from the advisor's two 'security_definer_function_executable' lints, which list only definer functions anon or authenticated can run; a definer function only service_role can run is missing from the list. settings and acl are therefore not read.

no search_path flag: computed from the advisor instead of settings. The advisor's 'function_search_path_mutable' lint (which checks every public function) returned 0 rows, so 0 functions lack a fixed search_path by the advisor's reading.

Query 4b (routine_privileges) filters grantee in lowercase 'public'; Postgres reports the PUBLIC pseudo-role as 'PUBLIC', so default PUBLIC execute grants do not appear in grants. Treat anon/authenticated advisor rows as the evidence of open execute.
Advisor rls_enabled_no_policy (100 rows) matches the table query exactly for schema public; the 9 storage-schema tables with 0 policies are Supabase-managed and not in the advisor.
